scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "${npm_config_user_agent-}" in npm/*|yarn/*) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.ci:publish: pnpm --filter @sverg84/kkds-common run build && pnpm --filter @sverg84/kkds-react run build:lib && changeset publish
